system.description:
Don't stop moving when a blow lands — the momentum carries your weapon on into whoever is next. You may use the Cleave manoeuvre up to twice per turn instead of once (three times a turn with a Cleaving weapon).

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
